title: Nvidia invests $30B in OpenAI, replacing the $100B plan

sources.quote: Nvidia and SoftBank are each investing $30bn.

Nvidia is close to finalising a $30 billion equity investment in OpenAI, the Financial Times reported Thursday, in a deal that replaces the $100 billion multiyear infrastructure commitment the two companies announced last September.
Under the proposed terms, Nvidia would take a direct stake in OpenAI, replacing a previously mooted $100 billion multi‑year investment announced in 2025 but never formalised.

explain: Instead of the earlier 'up to $100 billion' plan tied to data center build-outs, Nvidia bought $30 billion of OpenAI shares outright in OpenAI's 2026 funding round, which closed at $122 billion. Much of OpenAI's new money is expected to flow back to Nvidia for chips.
